input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law (with CISG excluded) and 28.2 confers exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County, with each Party submitting to personal jurisdiction and waiving venue/forum objections. That matches our preferred position exactly. No arbitration provision exists anywhere in the document, so there is no foreign seat concern. The carve-out permitting temporary injunctive relief elsewhere and the 28.3 executive escalation (which expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings) are mutual and do not displace the New York courts. Compliant at the preferred position; no redline.
